description: This file defines an abstract class 'PrimaryOperationFailed' that models connection issues related to primary storage constraints within the Orleans.EventSourcing.Common namespace. It includes properties for exception handling and logic for computing retry delays with exponential backoff.

classes.name: PrimaryOperationFailed
classes.description: An abstract class representing a failure in communicating with primary storage during an operation. It includes exception details and retry delay logic.

methods.name: ComputeRetryDelay
methods.description: Calculates the delay before retrying an operation based on previous failure timing, employing exponential backoff with some randomness.
